## Learning path

1. **Opening:** course introduction and Markov decision processes.
2. **Core methods:** an accelerated, provisionally scheduled sequence of computational methods and machine-learning foundations.
3. **Research literature:** several closing sessions on recent computational economics using ML, with papers still to be chosen.

Each week includes a lecture, a research-tools lab, and placeholders for reading and exercise homework. Topic decks can span sessions.

[Start with Week 1](weeks/week_01/index.qmd) · [View all 13 weeks](syllabus.qmd)

## Course updates

The course materials are being revised week by week. Existing topic handouts are available through the sidebar. The research-agent labs, weekly homework, and literature selections are being redesigned; placeholders are not assignments. Dates and deadlines for the next offering will be announced separately.
